text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Minister of Labour and Social Affairs Abdul-Hamid Aziz Mohammad Saleh who was appointed in December and newly appointed Mayor of Baghdad Noori Faisel al-Shaher are sworn in, in front of President Saddam Hussein.
- Saddam chairs cabinet meeting in which the cabinet says the U.S. is impeding the arrival of food and medical supplies.
- Police arrest a thief who robbed a private bank in Baghdad.
(All the above stories, except the last, were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
